dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed set of four prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings on the lateral flank; perimeter geometry is characterized by irregular, high-contrast borders with a sharp gradient transition from dark exterior fur to light interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, localized high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the anterior and mid-dorsal regions; these blobs lack an internal gradient and appear as distinct asymmetrical points between macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the central flank region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side oriented parallel to the spinal axis.
